items.title: File objection (Einspruch) against the fine notice
items.quote: Er muss binnen zwei Wochen ab der Zustellung schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift beim Landkreis Beispielheide eingelegt werden.
items.computation: The delivery slip on page 2 (Zustellungsurkunde) states the actual formal delivery date: 'zugestellt am 17.10.2025' (Friday). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of delivery itself is not counted, so the two-week objection period starts 18.10.2025. Under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, a period stated in weeks ends on the day of the last week bearing the same name as the triggering day, i.e. Friday 31.10.2025. But 31.10.2025 is Reformationstag, a public holiday in Niedersachsen, so under § 43 StPO (i.V.m. § 46 Abs. 1 OWiG) the deadline shifts to the next working day: Monday 03.11.2025.

items.title: Pay the total fine amount (Gesamtbetrag)
items.quote: Der Gesamtbetrag ist zwei Wochen, nachdem der Bescheid rechtskräftig geworden ist, fällig; geben Sie bei der Überweisung bitte das Aktenzeichen an.
items.computation: The notice becomes final (rechtskräftig) only if no Einspruch is filed by the end of the objection period computed above, i.e. at the end of 03.11.2025. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB, that day itself is not counted, so the two-week payment period starts 04.11.2025 and, under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, ends on the corresponding weekday two weeks later: Monday 17.11.2025. That day is a normal working day in Niedersachsen (no weekend or holiday shift needed). This date only applies if no objection is filed by 03.11.2025; filing an Einspruch removes the finality (and thus this payment deadline) entirely.

warnings: The 03.11.2025 objection deadline is computed from the actual delivery date printed on the Zustellungsurkunde copy ('zugestellt am 17.10.2025') on page 2, not from the letter's own date (13.10.2025) — verify this against the original delivery envelope/slip if it is available.
The 17.11.2025 payment deadline only applies if no Einspruch is filed by 03.11.2025; if an objection is filed, the notice does not become final and this payment obligation and date no longer apply.

The bank details (Kreissparkasse Beispielheide, IBAN DE61 2585 1660 0000 0055 66) appear consistent with the sender's own letterhead and the IBAN is well-formed, but a valid IBAN does not by itself prove ownership — compare it against other official correspondence before paying.
